title: Python Workers are now generally available
contentSnippet: Python Workers allow developers to run Python web frameworks and AI orchestration libraries natively in the Cloudflare Workers runtime. You can seamlessly integrate with Cloudflare's ecosystem including D1, R2, and Workers AI without writing any JavaScript glue code.

title: Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence
contentSnippet: OpenAI is working with an independent Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence to guide the review and communication of emerging AI results.

title: Higgsfield AI ships new video features in a day with GPT-6 Astra

title: Building standards for the next phase of AI
